whole_chain: TubeJunctionBlockEntity constructs parent tier-two4000 handler and separate tube2 tier-two4000 handler. Parent saves/loads normal AirHandler child; junction separately saves/loads tube2 compound using same MachineAirHandler pair.

BasicAirHandler serializes raw Air only; MachineAirHandler adds optional Leaking direction. Base volume comes from constructed owner, volumeUpgrades from owned upgrades, connection caches and connectableFaces are derived runtime state. Missing tube2 compound reads empty => Air0/leaknull.

For blockstate axis X, Y-facing pair returns tube2 and Z-facing pair returns parent; axis Y maps Z to tube2 and X parent; axis Z maps X to tube2 and Y parent. Faces on block axis return null; null-face lookup returns parent, not both.

AbstractAirHandlingBlockEntity.onLoad runs initializeHullAirHandlers before super; identity map groups actual returned handlers with their two directions, invalidates capabilities and sets each handler connectableFaces. Rotation/neighbor updates rebuild; rotation clears both leak directions but retains each handler air.

TubeJunctionBlock implements PneumaticCraftEntityBlock actualticker: tickCommonPre before client/server methods. Parent tickCommonPre iterates identity-map keys once, so both restored reservoirs tick.

CapabilitySetup registers AIR_HANDLER_MACHINE for matching registered BE types using actual virtual getAirHandler(dir); TUBE_JUNCTION registry plus dummy-BE stream confirm inclusion. PNCCapabilities level lookup passes requested direction.

MachineAirHandler.getConnectedAirHandlers enumerates only its rebuilt face bitset and gets neighbour opposite-side capability; disperseAir considers lower-pressure neighbours then calculates volume-weighted target and debits source/credits neighbour. Junction does not implement IAirListener extra connections, so no direct internal bridge of its two reservoirs. External topology may reconnect them.

Block wrench changes blockstate axis then calls onBlockRotated, rebuilding direction mapping without swapping stored parent/tube2 identities. Placement axis derives clicked face. Native blockstate disk persistence not independently reviewed here.

semantic_dedup.difference: Read actual full VacuumPump source for comparison: pump has positive input and opposite vacuum output, consumes positive air to lower vacuum toward-0.99; junction is passive orthogonal pair identity rebuilt from AXIS with no direct internal bridge. Shared second-handler Air/Leaking serializer and factory count0; accepted only full geometric reconstruction and concrete network consumer as one mechanism.

PressureTube persists polymorphic installed modules and per-side masks. Junction has no module list or registry payload; physical split reservoir identity survives separate connection reconstruction. Common parent/handler routines support0.
Dynamo restores FE balance and pays pressure for FE generation; junction has no FE conversion. Generic pressure parent is not separately counted.

static_limits: No claim of two credits for two identical Air compounds or enum/side variants. One whole concrete crossing topology-custody mechanism.

Missing/wrong-type tube2 resets that reservoir to0 through getCompound/getInt; unknown payload not quarantined. Raw Air allows negative vacuum and has no read bounds. No lossless corrupt-data guarantee.

onLoad reconstructs topology from current native blockstate; if schema/AXIS changes, identity of external consumers can change. Native blockstate chunk/version migration not traced; no runtime round-trip.
MachineAirHandler uses int totalAir/volume accumulation and no transactional external debit-credit contract. Integer overflow, partial third-party behavior or cross-crash atomicity not ruled out.
Air mutations do not directly call owner.setChanged in reviewed handler code; defaultServerTick synchronizes fields. All pressure changes durable-on-disk dirty scheduling not proved.
Loaded leakDir is not necessarily normalized against new connectableFaces on load; rotation explicitly clears it. New disconnected-face leak discovery for junction is not asserted.
Client initializeHullAirHandlerClient clears map then adds just packet-selected handler; no claim simultaneous two-channel client visualization was verified.

Volume upgrade decreases intentionally reduce air proportional to volume; pending item air applies next server tick with pressure cap. Full block-item placement/break serialization is not part of this review.
Specialist readings/parallel time and source hash checks are not extra semantic reference or coordinator-hour credit.
application_to_dynasty: Later migration design should preserve each owned independent resource pool while rebuilding disposable connection maps from current owner schema; copying one primary handler or generic player Clone compound is insufficient. Do not infer permanent quest rewards from network pressure or derived faces. Relevant1000 gate remains unmet.
